lesson.grammar_point: present simple for role and identity

listenings.text: Good morning, everyone. My name is Rafael Antunes and I am based in Sao Paulo, in Brazil. I work for a bank, and I am responsible for operations for our corporate clients. That means my team makes sure that every deal we sign actually works, from the paperwork to the money. I am in charge of about thirty people, and I have been doing this for fifteen years. Why am I here? Honestly, because I want to hear how other people solve the same problems I have. And because I would like to stop talking about spreadsheets for two weeks. Thank you.

Welcome, everyone, and thank you for being on time. A few practical things before we start. The first session begins at nine, in room two hundred and four, on the second floor. Please bring the case you received by email, printed or on your laptop, because we will work on it in groups. Coffee is at half past ten, outside the room. Lunch is at half past twelve, at tables of six, and there is a name on each table, so please look for yours. Finally, the wifi password is on the back of your badge. Enjoy the programme.
